id: title:Gilbert09:stop retrying syncs with no incremental field set

review.posthog_relevance: Adds a configuration error message for warehouse ingestion, potentially improving user guidance when Meta Ads warehouse setup fails due to missing incremental fields.
review.reason: Adds a new error message and its associated user-facing guidance to the `get_non_retryable_errors` dictionary, and adds this error message to the expected list of errors in a unit test.
review.uncertainty: This chunk does not include the implementation of the error message or the configuration parsing that generates the error, only the addition of the error message to a dictionary and its inclusion in a test assertion. This makes it impossible to verify the root cause, the configuration parsing, or the actual recovery behavior.
